[1/2] Review the last 33 pushes: make reforge restore atomic

impact_assessment.why: _restore wrote snapshot bytes directly; a disk error or crash could leave a partially restored file.
impact_assessment.benefits: Restore uses temp+fsync+replace and reports a failed restore without leaving partial bytes.

[1/2] Review the last 36 pushes: fsync the hook directory after the atomic replace

impact_assessment.why: install_pre_push_hook fsyncs the temp file and replaces it but never fsyncs the containing directory, so on POSIX a power loss can revert the rename and leave the project unguarded.
impact_assessment.benefits: The hook rename is durable like every other PRINCIPLE-013 state write; Windows stays a no-op.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: publish guard durability; dependency: disruption_recovery.fsync_dir; concurrency: none; state: git_guard.py, tests, ADR, map

[1/2] Review the last 39 pushes: resolve a local includeIf hooksPath through git config

impact_assessment.why: The file parser ignores [includeIf] sections, so a core.hooksPath set by a conditional include is missed and the guard installs in .git/hooks instead of where git looks.
impact_assessment.benefits: A local conditional include is resolved by Git's own config; the parser remains the no-subprocess default when no includeIf is present.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: publish guard config discovery; dependency: git for conditional configs; concurrency: none; state: git_guard.py, tests, ADR, map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first includeIf test with a mocked config reader, targeted guard tests, unit tier, root scan and gates

[1/2] Review the last 42 pushes: recognize archive banners case-insensitively

impact_assessment.why: update_readme_for_archive and extract_readme_description match only the exact title-case banner; a legacy or hand-edited lowercase banner is treated as the description and a re-archive adds a second banner.
impact_assessment.benefits: One banner is recognized in any case, the original description survives a re-archive, and the GitHub description is not the archive reason.
